concept: X-Ray: distributed tracing to find latency in microservices
tests: Choosing a tool to find a slow downstream call in a request spanning several services.
expected: AWS X-Ray — distributed tracing and a service map show latency and errors per request segment. Triggers: "which downstream call is adding latency", "microservices", "request flowing through several services".
why_not: CloudWatch dashboards are aggregated metrics without an end-to-end trace; CloudTrail is API auditing; Logs Insights queries log text without a service map.
